localBiteReport: The most current report available (September 18–24, 2026 week) from Great Days Outdoors' Northwest Florida Fishing Report indicates that inshore fishing around Destin and Choctawhatchee Bay is putting up some of the best action guides have seen all year. Redfish are the headline bite, with both slot-sized and oversized fish spread throughout the bay system, from the East Pass all the way into Santa Rosa Sound. An abundance of bait moving into bayous, flats, and bridge areas is also benefiting flounder and trout, which are actively feeding. Water temperature at this location is 86°F. The fall transition is underway, with bait pushing shallower and guides expecting redfish and general flats activity to keep improving through October.
